# Small Linux launcher format fixtures (#93)
Original synthetic JSON and inert labelled target files, generated by xtask.
No user launcher data was read or copied. Format-only references checked on
27 October 2026:
- https://github.com/sharkwouter/minigalaxy (config.py install_dir,
  paths.py config layout; game.py legacy minigalaxy-info settings).
- https://github.com/Faugus/faugus-launcher (path_manager.py data/config
  migration, launcher.py games array fields and playtime in seconds).
No code/tests copied. Minigalaxy uses GOG FileTask metadata when available.
Legacy info-only games do not invent GOG IDs. Faugus naive local timestamps
are not converted to epoch seconds without a captured timezone. Its shell hooks
and arbitrary launch-environment commands are deliberately not executed.
